name: fiducial_grasp_partial_20261117
tolerance_basis: Provisional protocol gates (5 mm / 2 deg); not a measured physical grasp tolerance.

sources.notes: Held-out final base error from the 14-pose bus-servo hand-eye dataset (3.29 mm); the same dataset reports 3.41 mm leave-one-out std. Treated as a bound, not a Gaussian sigma.
Held-out final base rotation error (0.43 deg); treated as a bound.
Worst of 15/15 semi-synthetic poses on real camera frames; the marker was composited, not physically present. This is a relative-pose detection error.
Worst semi-synthetic rotation error (0.53 deg); treated as a bound.
The 30-50 trial repeatability protocol is implemented but has no hardware data.
Angular repeatability has not been measured.
The forward/reverse backlash protocol is implemented but has no hardware data.
No real grasp has been executed; execution error is unknown.
No real grasp has been executed; angular execution error is unknown.
The gripper tolerance-envelope protocol is implemented but has no hardware data; gripper sign/range is still unverified.
The physical fixture ground truth has not been measured with a caliper or guide.

limitations: Partial budget: repeatability, backlash, grasp execution, gripper placement and object-fixture pose are unmeasured.
Hand-eye and fiducial values are maxima, not 1-sigma estimates; RSS is indicative and worst case is conservative.
The 5 mm / 2 deg tolerance is a provisional protocol gate, not a measured physical grasp tolerance.
The fiducial term comes from a composited marker on real frames, not a physically present marker.
